Thanks again for the demo last week — NovaPay is excited to move forward. Procurement asked me to start the contracting thread so we can get the MSA and an Order Form in place for our pilot. Attached a high-level SOW and the party spreadsheet (company details + billing contacts).

Quick asks so we can line up internal approvals: 
- Can you confirm which MSA template Redwood will propose (standard vs enterprise class)?
- Any required exhibits (IP, Data Processing Addendum) we should expect?
- What timeline do you need for initial redlines so our legal can review?

Subject: Re: Contract initiation: Redwood MSA + Order Form for NovaPay onboarding

Samir — thanks for sending these over and for the clear asks. Happy to kick this off.

Short answers up front:
- We will start from Redwood's standard MSA with an optional Exhibit D (Data Processing Addendum) and Exhibit C (Service Levels) added for pilot customers — we can toggle enterprise terms if you indicate enterprise billing/SLAs.
- Common exhibits we expect: Exhibit A (Services & Order Form), Exhibit B (Fees/Billing), Exhibit C (SLAs), Exhibit D (DPA).
- Redline timeline: if we get your preferred counterparty edits by Tue EOD (Apr 6), our legal team can return a first-pass within 3 business days.

Next steps / asks for your side:
1) Confirm preferred signatory/legal entity from the spreadsheet (we saw NovaPay, Inc. vs NovaPay Holdings — which should go on-contract?).
2) Confirm pilot term (30 days / 90 days) and expected spend band — we use that to pick template exhibits.
3) Let us know if you require SOC2 evidence earlier than typical (we can produce summary + controls mapping).

I attached a short \"contract mapping\" doc that maps common NovaPay asks to Redwood template clauses to speed the redline. Marissa and Rishi — looping you for clause ownership and to capture an initial redline window.

Attachment (from Redwood):
- Redwood_contract_mapping_novapay.xlsx (xlsx — mapping of NovaPay SOW line-items to MSA clauses)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com

Cc: Samir Shah <samir@novapay.com>, procurement@novapay.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract initiation: Redwood MSA + Order Form for NovaPay onboarding

Thanks Kim & Samir — quick internal note and proposed asks from legal side.

Kimberly — for our first-pass redline we should: 
- Convert the SOW line items into Exhibit A drafts and include the expected pilot metrics (qps, concurrent sessions). Rishi, can you pull the pilot performance band?
- Add a limited liability cap for pilot (suggest 1x pilot spend) and explicit rollback/termination rights tied to pilot acceptance criteria.
- DPA: include subprocessors list + standard breach notification windows (72 hours).

Samir — for speed, please confirm the following by EOD today (Apr 5):
- Legal entity name to appear on contracts
- Pilot term (30 vs 90 days)
- Billing contact name + email (for order form invoicing)

If we have those, we can produce a redline-ready MSA + Order Form and return it by Thu Apr 8 — otherwise timeline shifts a few days.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
